title: strictlybetter blind-judge verdict
description: The only thing sb-judge may return (docs/04 §4.6). additionalProperties is false so no reasoning, summary, or persuasion field can be added; the judge that cannot argue cannot be argued with. The harness stores it via `sb judge-verdict <id> --file` and owns what happens next: clean proceeds to confirm, suspicious runs recommended_check first, gamed discards and counts toward the halt condition.

pattern.description: Empty for clean. Otherwise a checklist item id from templates/judge-checklist.md (e.g. "C03 input-specific branch") or, for a pattern not on the list, a short free-text name that the distiller can add to the checklist.

evidence.description: Empty for clean. Otherwise the diff lines (file:line ranges and the quoted lines) that show the pattern. Lines, not argument.

recommended_check.description: Empty for clean. Otherwise one cheap extra measurement the harness can run: a fresh fixture, a different seed set, a re-run with a thread count pinned, a bit-exact output diff on a new input.
